N-S north of Kinsey; south of Kinsey it angles SSE behind the Highland Av lots
north line angles between the left edge and x~650 (street widens from 39'6" on 192 to 50'); centre drifts from y~3392 at x 330 to 3375

ends.note: the 40' SSE continuation south of Kinsey stops behind the rear lots of 2402 Highland Av (dead end; its east line stops at y~3146)

notes: North is up. Printed names: 'E. McMILLAN' (60'), 'PARIS', 'MAPLEWOOD AV.' (north section x~1461, 50'; south section between McCormick and Helen x~1866->1853, printed 40'), 'HIGHLAND AV.' (50' north of Kinsey, 60' on the diagonal south of Kinsey), 'CUMBERLAND' with '(NOT OPEN)' (40'), 'KINSEY AV.', 'McCORMICK PL.', 'HELEN', 'NELSON AV.'; names without a suffix written with 'Street'. Maplewood jogs at McCormick: the north section (McMillan-Kinsey-McCormick, crossing Kinsey) ends at McCormick and the south section starts ~400 px further east, so both Maplewood/McCormick points are T; the second end entry marks the jog. South of Helen the street printed 'NELSON AV.' (x~2116, 50') starts about 260 px east of Maplewood's south section; the key map labels that street on sheet 184 as 'MAPLEWOOD (NELSON)'. Highland continues north of McMillan into the Volume 4 area (gap in the north block line x 2598-2772 with a 4" water pipe); that leg is unlabelled here, recorded as a cross. Paris, Maplewood and Cumberland meet McMillan as T (north block line continuous). Paris ends at Kinsey (T); Kinsey continues west onto 192 and east onto 194 (where it is printed KINSLEY). Cumberland continues south of Kinsey as an angled 40' strip (open to Kinsey; its 40' label appears on sheet 194, which draws the same strip) and dead-ends behind the Highland lots; the strip's east line is also the match line with sheet 194. McCormick ends at Highland (T; the east side of Highland is a continuous row of lots). Helen runs across the bottom from the left edge to the right edge. The long empty parcel east of the Cumberland strip and the big yellow building at lower right are sheet 194 territory. No alleys.
